sentence: Bring your dubombo. Your sonbrella already knows which part you kept.

wombos.definition: A catch-all term for a close companion who embodies son, bro, and fella energy simultaneously — a versatile term of endearment for a trusted friend.
wombos.example: Me and my sonbrella have been rolling together for years.

wombos.definition: A winning wombo — a portmanteau that lands perfectly, earns its place in the vocabulary, and deserves full recognition as a quality coinage.
wombos.example: 'Brunch' is the original dubombo — timeless, clean, universally understood.
